# Harbour exhibit notes

- Venue: St Brannoc's Hall, Friday 12 to Sunday 14 December 2026. Set-up is on the Thursday evening.
- We have 8 free-standing panels (A1 size) and 2 glass cases.
- The society holds about 40 photographs (1890 to 1960), a harbour map from 1911, three fishermen's ledgers and 12 recorded interviews with old fishermen.
- Not everything will fit.
- Mairi writes the panel text, and the library prints it.
